name: Tech-Priest Dominus

bonuses.name: Master of Machines
bonuses.text: A Tech-Priest Dominus automatically reduces the time by half for any Tech test. They add +4d on Tech tests made to fix or repair a damaged machine.

bonuses.name: Masterwork Bionics
bonuses.text: At the beginning of each of the Dominus' turns, its advanced auto-repair systems restore d3 lost wounds.

bonuses.name: Lord of the Machine Cult
bonuses.text: The Dominus is considered to have an Enhanced Data Tether. All friendly <FORGE WORLD> units that have a Noospheric connection with the Dominus may reroll any 1s on a single attack test each turn.

abilities.name: Attacks
abilities.text: A Tech-priest Dominus may take one of these weapon packages:
